Proxied to deeplocpro.whole_genome rate (a=0.1214, b=28.9) since both are transformers on the same input and SignalP was killed incomplete (true time unmeasured; concurrent DLP took 5.56h). low_confidence kept True -> 3x margin -> ~16h cap. Refit officially once the rerun measures SignalP directly. See openspec/changes/size-aware-tool-timeouts/calibration_observations.md. || 2026-07-12: hh_suite.substrates added as a hand-set PRIOR (a=35, b=600, method=prior, n=0) because there is still no clean HH-suite calibration point (the only rows are wallclock=null). Previously hh_suite had no block, so its outer timeout was hardcoded flat at 4h and killed the pooled full-tier reruns 3261357 (74 genomes, ~593 substrates) + 3261459 (57, ~768) mid-step. a=35 s/substrate sits just above the observed >=24 s/substrate lower bound (kill point) and between plm_blast (38) and eggnog (19); with the low_confidence 3x margin a ~600-substrate pool caps at ~18h, small runs stay at the 4h floor. Refit once a full-tier run COMPLETES hh_suite and yields a real point. || 2026-07-12: blastp moved from the _WHOLE (fixed) set to _ANNOT (substrates) — it BLASTs the substrate/passenger set, not the whole proteome — and given a hand-set PRIOR (a=20, b=300, method=prior, n=0). No blastp calibration point exists. Sized for the slow opt-in NR path (Swiss-Prot, the full-tier default, finishes in minutes and stays well under any timeout); small runs keep the 4h floor, a ~768-substrate NR run caps at ~13h. Refit once an NR run yields a real point. || 2026-07-15: eggnog refit VERIFICATION (adaptive-runtime-estimate). Recomputed the OLS fit over all 74 fittable rows in runs.jsonl (wallclock_s present, success!=false, n_substrates present, non-excluded): result is IDENTICAL to the shipped a=19.2616/b=320.939/LOO=137.5, i.e. the current fit is already optimal for the data. The 137% LOO is intrinsic, not stale: eggnog wall-clock is dominated by cold-vs-warm DB cache (39 GB load: warm ~90-400s, NFS-cold ~1000-8500s) independent of substrate count, which a linear a*size+b cannot capture. The scratch-staging fix (annotation-subsystem-cleanup: DB copied to local SSD, no NFS mmap) removes the worst cold outliers going forward. No coefficient change made. Revisit only if a dbmem-on/off split or a cache-state feature is added to the model.
